items.name: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.plain: A faster, cheaper everyday AI model from Google that handles coding and multi-step assistant tasks, now built into Search and the Gemini app for every user.
items.summary: Google's fast new Gemini 4 model for everyday coding and agentic work, completing tasks about 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash — now the default model in Search's AI Mode, the Gemini app and AI Studio.

items.name: Gemini Decision 1
items.plain: A Google AI that answers yes/no and multiple-choice questions with confidence scores, so apps can route work and check policies without waiting on a chat model.
items.summary: Google's first decision model: instead of generating text, it scores up to 1,000 yes/no, choice or rubric questions over text, images, audio, video or PDFs in a single pass, returning probabilities and confidence scores.

items.name: AlphaGenome 2
items.plain: A Google DeepMind model that helps scientists see how DNA changes act inside specific cell types, speeding up the search for what drives disease.
items.summary: DeepMind's next-generation DNA model predicts how genetic variants affect specific human cell types, trained on over 100 million cell profiles, and is available now for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API.

items.name: Gemini Robotics 2.5
items.plain: Google's newest robot-brain model that turns what a robot sees into skilled hand movements, already tested on real car-factory lines.
items.summary: DeepMind's most capable vision-language-action model yet, evaluated across 200+ tasks from food service to pipetting, and proven on live Mercedes-Benz production lines where Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoids hit 96% kitting success.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.2
items.plain: Anthropic's strongest AI model for hard technical work, now faster and cheaper, with a locked-down twin for approved security research teams.
items.summary: Anthropic's most capable model yet, generating output up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1 at a 20% lower price, with a restricted Mythos 5.2 twin for vetted cybersecurity and biology work.
